title: Magic Cube Kronecker Extension + Composite Analysis

findings.title: Kronecker extension scales identically to Lo Shu
findings.detail: Level-n Kronecker product: M_n = 42^n, secondary = 9 × 42^(n-1). Full rank at every level, zero null dimensions. Same multiplicative eigenvalue scaling as Lo Shu (M_n = 15^n, sec = 2√6 × 15^(n-1)).
findings.formula: secondary_n = invariant × M^(n-1), invariant = 9 for cube, 2√6 for Lo Shu

findings.title: 9×9 cyclic composite IS magic — mirrors Navagraha structure exactly
findings.detail: Block-circulant 9×9 from the 3 cube layers: M_composite = 126 = 3×42. Eigenvalues {126, ±2.598, ±2.598, 0, 0, 0, 0}. Rank 5, null 4. This is the SAME rank/null structure as the Navagraha 9×9 composite (rank 5, null 4).
findings.navagraha_comparison: Navagraha 9×9: M=81, rank 5, null 4 — identical topology

findings.title: Lo Shu-weighted composite collapses spectrum further
findings.detail: Placing cube layers at Lo Shu positions (mod 3) yields M=126 but eigenvalues collapse toward {126, 0, 0, ...}. The Lo Shu weighting concentrates all spectral energy into the uniform mode — maximum coherence.
findings.interpretation: Lo Shu ordering is the maximally coherent arrangement of the 3D layers

findings.title: Perfect isotropy — all axis means = 14 exactly
findings.detail: Mean value along layers, rows, and columns all = 14.0 = (1+27)/2. No axis is privileged. The cube is spectrally isotropic in all three tensor modes (σ₁ = 72.75 for all three).

findings.title: Centered layers: spectral mirror symmetry {-9, 0, +9}
findings.detail: After centering (subtract 14): Layer 0 evals {0, -9, -9}, Layer 1 evals {0, 0, 0}, Layer 2 evals {9, 9, 0}. The outer layers are ±9 mirrors, middle layer is null. The non-trivial spectrum lives entirely in the shell.

findings.title: Composite secondary eigenvalue ±2.598 ≈ ±3×2√6/√(2·3·9)?
findings.detail: The cyclic composite secondary ±2.598 needs algebraic identification. Note: 2.598 ≈ 3×√(3)/2 = 2.598. CHECK: 3√3/2 = 2.5981. YES — the composite invariant is 3√3/2, replacing 3·2√6 from the Navagraha composite (which has secondary 14.697 = 3×2√6).

findings.title: 2D→3D invariant transition: irrational→rational
findings.detail: 2D Lo Shu invariant ±2√6 is irrational. 3D cube invariant ±9 = ±3² is rational (perfect square). The 3D composite invariant 3√3/2 reintroduces irrationality at the composite level. Pattern: base invariant rationality alternates with dimension.
